steps.description: Land on the border can walk straight off the grid, and so can any land joined to it. Mark all of that first with a DFS from each border land cell; whatever interior land is left unmarked is an enclave.
(1,0) is unvisited land on the border - it can walk off. dfs(1,0) marks everything joined to it.
dfs(1,0): mark it visited - it can reach the border.
dfs(1,0) is done. Return to the caller.
(1,2) is interior land no border DFS reached, so it cannot walk off: an enclave cell. cnt = 1.
(2,1) is interior land no border DFS reached, so it cannot walk off: an enclave cell. cnt = 2.
(2,2) is interior land no border DFS reached, so it cannot walk off: an enclave cell. cnt = 3.
3 land cells cannot reach the border.
